name: learners-high
description: 러너스하이(Learners High) — 학습 매니지먼트 플랫폼 모노레포

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,mock-ai -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w @learners-high/backend" "npm run dev -w @learners-high/frontend" "npm run mock-ai -w @learners-high/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @learners-high/shared && npm run build -w @learners-high/backend && npm run build -w @learners-high/frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @learners-high/shared && npm run typecheck -w @learners-high/backend && npm run typecheck -w @learners-high/frontend
scripts.verify:p0: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run build-storybook && npm run check-db && npm run test:e2e
